title: Same Page · Drawing together, silent turns
brief: Draw this scene together on this 400 by 400 canvas: a fox stealing a picnic in the rain. Use simple shapes (no text, letters or digits anywhere). You take turns and you cannot talk: the only way to agree is through the drawing. When you finish, someone who knows nothing about it will be shown the picture and asked what it shows; it should name every part of the scene.

checks.say: The document is one complete SVG.
